what: The hidden truth this example's simulator plays as the real hardware. Only the simulator that makes the measurements reads it (the example's RealWorld); identification never does (sysid/tests/test_oracle.py holds the identify functions to that), and it starts from the description's nominal values.
structure: conveyor.xml with the equality's radius, the belt body's mass and the slide's damping and frictionloss set to the truth (a worn, lagged roller; a heavier, draggier belt than drawn)
